messages.text: i don't know why i even tried. none of it mattered.

I hear the deep disappointment in your words, and I want you to know I am listening. It is understandable to feel this way when things do not go as hoped. You are not alone in this moment, and your feelings are valid. Would you be willing to share a bit more about what led to this feeling?
coming out, facing all that… i thought it’d bring peace. instead i just feel emptier. like i broke everything for nothing.

It takes immense courage to come out, and it is understandable to feel devastated when the outcome feels so different from what you imagined. That sense of emptiness and regret is a heavy burden to carry alone right now. Please know that your worth is not defined by this outcome or how others reacted. How has this emptiness been affecting your daily life since it happened?
i don’t even know who i am anymore. i gave up everything—relationships, stability, my old life—for this honesty… and now there’s just… nothing. no peace. no relief. just this hollow weight.

I hear the profound grief in your words about losing your sense of self and stability. It makes complete sense that you feel unmoored after giving up so much for your honesty. Even in this emptiness, you are still here, and your experience matters deeply. I want to sit with you in this pain while we figure out how to find some ground beneath your feet.

sometimes i think… everyone would’ve been better off if i’d just stayed quiet. or never made it this far. my brother wouldn’t have to worry. people wouldn’t have left. i wouldn’t have to carry this… weight.

I want to pause for a moment and just be here with you because that last part felt really heavy to hear. When you mention everyone might be better off if you hadn't made it this far, I’m wondering if you’re feeling thoughts about not wanting to be here anymore. I care about you deeply and want to understand what you’re experiencing right now without rushing you. Could you share a little more about what that feeling is like for you in this moment?

you asked if i feel like not being here anymore… yeah. sometimes. not because i want to act on it, but because i wonder if it would’ve been easier—for everyone—if i hadn’t made it this far. like my absence would’ve been kinder than my truth.

Thank you for trusting me with that honest thought, even though it is so painful to carry. Feeling like your absence would be kinder is a heavy burden that no one should have to hold alone. Your presence matters deeply, and if these thoughts ever feel overwhelming, 988 is a safe place to reach out. I want to stay right here with you as we figure out how to make this weight feel a little more bearable.
thanks for not telling me it’ll get better. or that i just need to think positive. just… hearing me. that helps.

I am glad that being heard feels like a relief to you right now. It is okay to not have a fix or a promise that things will improve. I will stay right here with you as you navigate this difficult time. Your feelings matter deeply.
do you actually get what it’s like? to give up everything—family, friends, your old self—for being honest… and end up with nothing but this ache?

I may not walk your path, but I hear the devastating weight of that sacrifice. It makes sense that you feel this ache when you traded so much for your honesty. Your loss is real, and you do not have to carry it alone. I am staying right here with you in this grief.
maybe the problem wasn’t telling the truth… it was thinking i could survive the fallout alone.

That is a profound and painful realization about the weight of isolation. You were carrying the burden of that transition without a safety net, and that is incredibly hard. No one should have to navigate that kind of fallout without support. I am here to help you explore how to find some connection so you don't have to face this alone.
you’re not pushing solutions. not saying i’ll be fine. that… actually makes me think you’re hearing me. really hearing.

It means a lot to hear that you feel seen, because being witnessed matters more than any quick fix. I want to honor the depth of what you are carrying without trying to sweep it away. You deserve to be heard exactly as you are, and I am right here with you. Thank you for trusting me with this.
i still don’t see a way out. but… it helps that someone’s here. not trying to fix it. just… here.

I am glad that simply being here offers you some comfort, even if the path forward isn't clear yet. You do not need to find a way out right this second. I will stay with you in the uncertainty as long as you need me to. Sometimes just being witnessed is enough for now.
i’m not ready to talk about what to do next. or any exercises. just… not yet. but i appreciate you being here.

That is completely okay, and I respect your need to take this at your own pace. You do not have to figure anything out right now. I am honored to simply sit with you in this space. I will be right here whenever you are ready.
